response.text:

The invoice amount is 6883.61 (per the finding), so the credit side is correct and the debit line was mistyped; the expense debit should be 6883.61. The difference is 9.00 on the debit side.

The finding says a mistyped amount may be corrected with a one-sided line. A correction that adds a 9.00 debit to 5200 in an open period (11 or 12) brings the group to balance: original DR 6874.61 + 9.00 = 6883.61 = CR. The original journal is 1364, so the correcting journal references it. Period 12 is open and matches the original period, so I'll use it. Account 5200 is active.

No invoice status changes: this is not a duplicate invoice finding.
